data.gender_notes: Sinead is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sín, meaning 'god' in Irish, and ead, meaning 'grace'. In Christian context, this name signifies God's grace and favor. The name Sinead carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sinead usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine grace and blessings.
data.etymology: Sinead belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sinead total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Sinead is derived from the Irish words "Sín," meaning 'god,' and "ead," meaning 'grace.' In a Christian context, it signifies the divine favor and blessings of God. It reminds us of the grace and favor bestowed upon us by God and encourages us to live meaningful and purposeful lives in His sight. It is a name that connects us to our spiritual heritage and invites us to seek God's presence in our daily lives.
